bio.text: Michael Baumgartner is serving his first term in the U.S. House of Representatives for Washington's 5th Congressional District.
He served eight years in the Washington State Senate, as Treasurer of Spokane County, and as a U.S. State Department officer at the U.S. Embassy in Baghdad, Iraq, from 2007 to 2008.
He earned an economics degree from Washington State University and a Master of Public Administration from Harvard University, and lives in Spokane.
